questions.question: For what does Psalm 65 especially praise God?
options: His everlasting covenant with David and with his royal house
His holy law that was given to Israel upon the mountain
His care for the earth, providing rain and a rich harvest
His righteous judgment of the nations from his holy throne
questions.answer: His care for the earth, providing rain and a rich harvest

questions.question: What does God do to the year, according to this psalm?

You crown the year with your _____.
